name: jev-skills
description: Keeps skills out of the context window. On every prompt and tool result, TypeSafe's Jev model reads the skill library and injects only the skills that are relevant right now.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai (console.typesafe.ai/keys). Passed to the hook as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
